title: GH Real Estate Zoho Contracts Authoring Standard
scope: Contract and clause content authored for GH Real Estate in Zoho Contracts

official_sources.title: Tailor the Settings as per Your Needs
Add document fields using text tags

clause_requirements.zoho_api_name_policy: Keep zoho_api_name null until the exact API name is read from authenticated tenant metadata; a non-null value requires tenant_verified status.
clause_requirements.library_question_policy: Write one plain-language question ending in a question mark that helps the contract owner choose the standard language or an approved alternate during contract creation.
clause_requirements.contract_type_override_policy: Use contract_type_question_overrides only when a contract type needs a more specific selection question; the library question remains required.
clause_requirements.language_variant_policy: Every clause has exactly one standard language variant and may have zero or more approved alternate variants. Every variant stores its reader-facing clause title separately with clause_title_style Heading 2; blocks contain only substantive language styled Heading 3-5 or Normal.
clause_requirements.legal_review_policy: A registry record and formatting validation do not constitute legal approval. Clause language must complete the repository's legal review process before publication.

semantic_style_map.notes: Apply only in the contract template outside clause-library records.

typography.scope: Zoho Contracts templates and clause content only

inter_font_availability.instruction: Confirm that Inter Regular and Inter Bold are available organization-wide in the connected Zoho Writer/Contracts tenant before publishing. If unavailable, stop and install the approved Inter Regular and Bold fonts organization-wide first. Seek a governed typography amendment only if installation is impossible; never silently substitute another font.

live_template_republish.instruction: Changing this repository standard does not restyle existing live templates. Update and republish each affected template through a reviewed change, then render and inspect a sample contract.
